outline.title: SultraKita v3
outline.summary: Dari marketplace lokal menuju social-commerce yang terpercaya. Ringkasan Master Prompt v3, audit baseline, hardening awal, dan jalur release production.
outline.image_plan: /home/ubuntu/upload/search_images/STK6aasFnAVU.jpg - Slide 1: SultraKita v3 introduction representing Kendari, Southeast Sulawesi (local context).

outline.title: Apa yang Sudah Dimiliki
outline.summary: Fondasi aktual repository: frontend static, API, Worker path, SQLite/sql.js, listing, auth, upload, messaging, analytics, dan SEO/PWA basics.

outline.title: Diagnosis Audit
outline.summary: Gap utama: authorization/ownership, dual verification fields, local persistence/upload, dan Express-Worker drift. Baseline test lulus 4/0.

outline.title: Master Prompt v3
outline.summary: Brief besar diubah menjadi program release bertahap dengan quality gates, migration discipline, runtime compatibility, acceptance criteria, dan rollback.

outline.title: Perbaikan server.js yang Sudah Diterapkan
outline.summary: Health error disclosure diperbaiki, OTP dibatasi lima percobaan, dan status verified seller disatukan secara kompatibel.

outline.title: Gap P0/P1 yang Masih Terbuka
outline.summary: Full authorization, OTP abuse controls, upload hardening, durable storage, runtime parity, membership checks, dan security regression tests masih diperlukan.

outline.title: Production Runbook
outline.summary: Urutan release: freeze, environment, backup/migration, pre-deploy checks, staging, production smoke test, observability, dan rollback.

outline.title: Definition of Done
outline.summary: Release candidate harus memenuhi security, data, marketplace, trust, messaging, UX, accessibility, SEO, performance, operations, tests, Git, dan rollback.

outline.title: Folder Update Repository
outline.summary: Folder baru updates/2026-08-22-v3-release berisi README, production runbook, dan server change log; update berikutnya mengikuti pola tanggal-nama-release.

outline.title: Roadmap Keputusan
outline.summary: Sekarang review baseline; berikutnya P0 auth/ownership; setelah stabil lanjut design system, discovery, listing, trust, social, dan messaging.

outline.title: Penutup
outline.summary: SultraKita diarahkan menjadi produk teknologi serius yang lokal, cepat, mobile-first, terpercaya, dan maintainable.
